class.name: MaszynaLegacyMemoryAction
class.description: Writes the masked fields of its memories, from its own values or from a [member source] memory ([code]Event.cpp:469-571, 876-961[/code]). The [code]*[/code] of the scenery - "leave this field as it is" - is a field left out of the [member mask].

members.member: The fields written; a field left out stays as it is.
[code]copyvalues[/code]: the memory the values are read from when the event runs; empty for the action's own values.

constants.constant: [code]addvalues[/code]: the text is appended, the values added ([code]MemCell.cpp:30-37[/code]).
An isolated section's own memory when the section is taken: value 2 made odd ([code]TIsolated::Modify()[/code], [code]Track.cpp:155-156[/code]).
An isolated section's own memory when it is free again: the low byte of value 2 cleared ([code]Track.cpp:128-130[/code]).
